questions.question:
The given bar graph shows the sales of cars from six branches of a dealer B1, B2, B3, B4, B5, B6, during two consecutive years 2018 and 2019. Blue color corresponds to the year 2018 and the light blue color corresponds to the year 2019.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/59920cb2084f75d0e38a1b47a6089a1dccb9783a8d7da2cafa70c132dbef6d23.png] 

The total sale of cars from all the branches in the year 2018 is what percentage less than the total sales of cars from all the branches in the year 2019? (correct to one decimal place)
questions.solution:
Total number of cars in 2018 

80 + 75 + 95 + 85 + 75 + 70 = 480

Total number of cars in 2019

110 + 105 + 65 + 95 + 95 + 80 = 550

Different between 2018 and 2019 

550 - 480 = 70 

Percentage less than the total sales cars from all the branches in the 2019 

⇒ frac{{70}}{{550}} times 100

⇒ 12.7

questions.question:
The given bar graph shows the imports and export (in crore Rs.) of steel for 5 years from 2014 to 2018.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/8eb66d66cd80e9f28667da52d77d9042a60c5e70bdf25776d3ed60bf5afc4224.png] 

What is the ratio of average export to average import over the five years?
questions.solution:
**Calculation:**

Total import in five years = 350 + 380 + 420 + 450 + 580 = Rs.2180 crores

Average import in five years = 2180/5 = Rs.436 crores

Total export in five years = 400 + 420 + 550 + 480 + 620 = Rs.2470 crores

Average export in five years = 2470/5 = Rs.494 crores

Required ratio = 494 : 436 = 247 : 218

**∴ the ratio of average export to average import over the five years is 247 : 218.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ce3683d9ee5ec397377fe1bee5f73e1f40b58e14d603e1ac584c16eb8f3165e4.png] 

What is the ratio of the average production of the refrigerators by companies A, B and E taken together for the year 2004-2005 to the average production of the refrigerators by companies C and D taken together for the year 2005-2006?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

We need to calculate the ratio of the average production of refrigerators by companies A, B, and E for the years 2004-2005 to the average production of refrigerators by companies C and D for the years 2005-2006.

**Formula used:**

Average production = (Total production) / (Number of companies)

**Calculation:**

From the bar graph:

**Production of refrigerators in 2004-2005:**

Company A: 110

Company B: 160

Company E: 300

Total production for A, B, and E in 2004-2005 = 110 + 160 + 300 = 570

Average production for A, B, and E in 2004-2005 = 570 / 3 = 190

**Production of refrigerators in 2005-2006:**

Company C: 370

Company D: 490

Total production for C and D in 2005-2006 = 370 + 490 = 860

Average production for C and D in 2005-2006 = 860 / 2 = 430

**Ratio:**

Ratio = 190 / 430

⇒ Ratio = 190:430

⇒ Ratio = 19:43

**∴ The required ratio is 19:43.**

If the total marks obtained by students be represented as a pie chart, then the central angle of the sector representing marks 200 or more but less than 300, is:

(correct to the nearest degree)
questions.solution:
**Formula used:**

Central angle of pie chart = (given frequency/total frequency) × 360°

**Calculation: **

Number of students who scored marks between 200 and 300 = 45 + 60 = 105

Total students = 30 + 45 + 60 + 35 + 40 + 35 = 245

Central angle of pie chart = 105/245 × 360° = 154°

**∴ The central angle of the sector representing marks 200 or more but less that 300 is 154° **

questions.question:
Given bar graph shows, total expenditure and the gross receipts of a company (in Rs. crores). Study the graph and answer the question that follows:

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/adf5900045ad0cd9280102de5b7b3c11ae5f7dbd61708d6cfd76452fb60239e1.png] 

In order to make a profit of 20% what should have been the gross receipts (in crore Rs.) in 1995-96, if the total expenditure remained the same?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Expenditure in the year 1995-96 = 5500

Profit % = 20%

**Formula used:**

Profit % = (Profit/Expenditure) × 100

Profit = Recipient - Expenditure

**Calculation:**

∵ Profit % = (Profit/Expenditure) × 100

⇒ 20 = (profit/5500) × 100

⇒ 20 = Profit/55

⇒ Profit = 55 × 20 = 1100

∴ Receipts = Expenditure + Profit

⇒ Receipts = 5500 + 1100

⇒ Receipts = 6600

**∴ The correct answer is 6600.**

Which state(s) has employed youth less than 80% of its total youth population?

questions.solution:

The percentage of employed youth in state A = (10.5/12) × 100 = 87.5%

The percentage of employed youth in state B = (7/8) × 100 = 87.5%

What is the ratio of percentages of boys and girls who got marks from 60% to 74%?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Number of boys whose marks range = 75% = 7

Number of girls whose marks range 60% - 74% = 53

Using the concept of percentage.

Total number of boys = 12 + 45 + 8 = 65

Total number of girls = 7 + 53 + 5 = 65

Percentages of boys who got marks from 60% to 74% = (45/65) × 100

⇒ The required percentage = 69.23%

Percentages of girls who got marks from 60% to 74% = (53/65) × 100

⇒ The required percentage = 81.53%

So, The ratio of percentages of boys and girls who got marks from 60% to 74% = (69.23%)/(81.53%) = 69.23 ∶ 81.53

**∴ The ratio of percentages of boys and girls who got marks from 60% to 74% is 69.23 ∶ 81.53.**
